r1Corrections.trigger: independent review of the evidence-only draft PR #41

a11DeadlineStatistics.loadCaveat: Every valid attempt ran under elevated system load. run2 proxies: 1-min loadavg ~14-15 on 10 cores. run3 (formal): 1-min loadavg 80.28-105.19 recorded in the rounds' own audits; no lab work was concurrent with run3 A11 (verified by artifact timestamps), so the spike is external system load. There is no normal-load sample, and n is far too small for any probability statement. The bounded-fail rate must not be read as a normal-load timeout probability for PR #38.

r1Corrections.b9ScopeClarification: The original B9 (chmod 555 on the whole cache) obstructed optimizer writes and exercised the 15s shutdown-deadline path, not the removeOwnedCache() deletion-retry mechanism. Targeted follow-ups B9R1 (EACCES: non-retryable, immediate close rejection), B9R2a (transient EPERM: retries recover, close resolves, cache fully removed - proving the retry mechanism) and B9R2b (permanent EPERM: retries exhausted, close rejects) now cover the deletion path. All four failure paths are fail-closed with distinct signatures.
